reliability.title: Latency & Fallback
reliability.description: App-side measurements only. Customer replies handled by n8n are not timed and do not appear here.
reliability.latencyNone: No timed calls in this window. Every logged call came from a channel that does not report latency.

reliability.fallbackNote: This is not a success rate. A call where every model failed writes no usage row, so failures cannot be counted here — only calls that were rescued by a backup model. A rising rate means the first-choice model is struggling.
